meta.title: Is the internet slow after dinner?
meta.about: A week of hourly speed tests, read from columnar JSON, flattened, averaged by hour of day and by day, with a one-line verdict as a JSON object.

values.sql: SELECT to_timestamp(unnest(t)) AS taken, unnest(down) AS down, unnest(up) AS up, unnest(ping) AS ping, unnest(err) AS err FROM file
SELECT hour(taken) AS hour, round(avg(down)) AS down_mbps, round(avg(ping), 1) AS ping_ms FROM a GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT taken::DATE AS day, count(*) AS tests, count(err) AS failed, round(avg(down)) AS down_mbps, round(avg(up)) AS up_mbps FROM a GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH h AS (SELECT hour(taken) AS hour, avg(down) AS down FROM a GROUP BY 1) SELECT json_object('slowest_hour', arg_min(hour, down), 'slowest_mbps', round(min(down)), 'fastest_mbps', round(max(down)), 'slower_by', round(100 * (1 - min(down) / max(down))) || '%') AS verdict FROM h
SELECT owner, string_agg(service, ', ' ORDER BY service) AS services, count(*) AS n FROM a GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC
